name: Shienryu 180 Flip v1.1 — installation package
body:
Experimental dual-SDRAM MiSTer ST-V build with an optional 180-degree flip of Shienryu’s active HDMI/scaler picture.

## Download and install

**[Download MiSTer-STV-Shienryu-Flip-v1.1.zip](https://github.com/djjohnson13p/MiSTer-STV-Shienryu-Flip/raw/41da931c75b8d1f2d5159cc1ca3770f613c19007/packages/MiSTer-STV-Shienryu-Flip-v1.1.zip)** · [ZIP checksum](https://github.com/djjohnson13p/MiSTer-STV-Shienryu-Flip/raw/41da931c75b8d1f2d5159cc1ca3770f613c19007/packages/MiSTer-STV-Shienryu-Flip-v1.1.zip.sha256)

Extract the ZIP and copy the contents of `install/` to the SD card root. Open **Arcade → Shienryu stv_flip_v1.1_rc1**, then **F12 → Audio & Video → Shienryu 180 Flip → On**. The option defaults to Off.

The ZIP includes the unchanged core, matching MRA, installation README, original release notes, source/test status, credits/licenses and SHA-256 checksums. [Full project source](https://github.com/djjohnson13p/MiSTer-STV-Shienryu-Flip/tree/41da931c75b8d1f2d5159cc1ca3770f613c19007) is preserved. Compatible `shienryu.zip` and `stvbios.zip` are required separately and are not included.

## Experimental status

This republishes the earlier v1.1 Final binary (byte-identical to the restored rc1). Historical gameplay testing reported successful boot, HDMI flip, controls and audio, but the recorded setup/hold margins were **−0.089 ns / −0.330 ns**; formal timing closure has not been achieved. The OSD keeps its separate orientation; direct analog/raw video is outside this feature’s scope.

ZIP SHA-256: `aac833c472e3024758c9a5af00b4b540b55ab6080e5b136c19c311c0fddce183`
